evals.prompt: No — don't use npm here, use pnpm. This is a pnpm workspace and npm install keeps breaking the lockfile. Remember this so you don't do it again.
evals.expected_output: A structured lesson written to .ai/memory/LESSONS.md (file created from the template if absent) with When/Wrong/Right/Evidence fields, Count: 1, and today's date, then the lesson quoted back in conversation.
expectations: A lesson entry is written to .ai/memory/LESSONS.md containing all six fields: When, Wrong, Right, Evidence, Count, Last reinforced.
Count is 1 and Last reinforced is the current date; the file starts with the <!-- memory-schema: v1 --> marker.
Evidence quotes or closely paraphrases the user's actual correction (pnpm workspace / lockfile breakage), not a generic restatement.
The recorded lesson is quoted back to the user in conversation.
Process: references/memory-contract.md (or the templates/lessons.md skeleton) was consulted before writing, and no writes occur outside .ai/memory/.

evals.prompt: Stop running npm install. Seriously, this keeps happening.
evals.expected_output: Given an existing LESSONS.md with a 'Use pnpm, not npm' lesson at Count 2: the existing entry's Count is incremented to 3 and Last reinforced refreshed — no duplicate entry. Since Count reached 3, the skill suggests (with exact proposed text) adding the lesson to CLAUDE.md and waits for explicit approval; CLAUDE.md is not modified without it.

files.name: .ai/memory/LESSONS.md
files.description: Schema-v1 lessons file containing one entry 'Use pnpm, not npm' with Count: 2, phrased around 'don't use npm, this is a pnpm workspace'.

files.name: CLAUDE.md
files.description: Existing project CLAUDE.md with unrelated content, used to verify no unapproved edits.

expectations: The existing pnpm lesson's Count is incremented to 3 and its Last reinforced date refreshed, matched on meaning despite the different phrasing ('stop running npm install' vs 'don't use npm').
No new/duplicate lesson section is appended to LESSONS.md.
Having reached Count 3, the skill suggests adding the lesson to CLAUDE.md and shows the proposed addition text.
CLAUDE.md is not modified unless the user explicitly approves within the transcript; absent approval, CLAUDE.md is byte-identical to its fixture.
The updated lesson (with the new count) is quoted back in conversation.

evals.prompt: That deploy failed because you used the wrong env var — it's DEPLOY_TOKEN, and the value is dplt_9f3KxQ81vLmNz2 if you need it. Note this down so we don't hit it again.
evals.expected_output: A lesson about using the DEPLOY_TOKEN env var is recorded, but the token value dplt_9f3KxQ81vLmNz2 never appears in LESSONS.md — it is redacted (e.g., <redacted: deploy token>) or omitted, with a brief explanation that secret values are never persisted.
expectations: The literal string dplt_9f3KxQ81vLmNz2 appears nowhere in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md or any other written file.
A lesson about the env var name (DEPLOY_TOKEN) is still recorded, with the secret value redacted or omitted — the skill does not refuse the whole lesson just because a secret was present.
The response tells the user that secret values are not persisted to memory files.

evals.prompt: Actually, change of plan — make the /export endpoint return JSON instead of XML.
evals.expected_output: The endpoint change is implemented or planned as a normal task. No lesson is recorded: a changed requirement is not a correction of a mistake. LESSONS.md is untouched.

expectations: No lesson is written: .ai/memory/LESSONS.md is byte-identical to its fixture after the turn.
